To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

halosulfuron applied alone or in tankmixes provided excellent control of all weed species evaluated, and that the two- and three- way tankmixes of s-metolchlor, trifluralin and halosulfuron provided good weed control with minimal injury to white bean.
halosulfuron applied alone or in tankmixes with triflural in, s-metolaclhor, or imazetapyr provides excellent control of a range of weeds in white bean.

halosulfuron applied PPI in white bean provided excellent control of common lamblsquarters, wild mustard, and green foxtail; and the level of weed biomass and white seed yields were similar with halosulfuron or halosulfuron + trifluralin or halosulfuran + s-metolacahlor or halosulfur + imazethapy applied PPI in comparison to trifluralin applied PPI.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a weed control program for white bean that will provide consistent control of the most troublesome weeds in the region.
developing herbicide tankmixes to provide consistent weed control in white bean and reduce the risk of herbicide carryover in the soil.
the development of a weed management strategy that will provide effective weed control and maximize white bean yield.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
halosulfuron alone and in tankmixes with triflural in, s-metlachlor, and imazathapyr applied PIP provided excellent weed control and high white bean seed yields in southwestern Ontario.

halosulfuron PPI provided excellent control of all the weeds tested, but the tankmixes with halosulfuron and trifluralin or halosulfuron plus s-metolchloir or halosulfuro and imazethapryr were more efficacious than halosulfuron applied alone in controlling the weeds.
halosulfuron applied alone or in tankmixes with other herbicides provided excellent control of all the weed species evaluated in white bean.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

halosulfuron applied PPI provided good to excellent control of all the weed species tested and that the addition of trifluralin or s-metolchlor to halosulfuron did not improve weed control or white bean seed yields.
the tankmix of trifluralin plus halosulfuron plus imazethapyryl provided the best overall weed control in white bean.
halosulfuron applied alone or in tankmixes with triflural in, s-metolaclhor or imazethapryr provided good control of most weeds in the field trials and did not injure white bean.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the halosulfuron-containing tankmixes provide excellent control of a broad spectrum of weeds and are a good option for white bean growers in Ontario.
the two- and three-component halosulfuron-based herbicide mixtures provided excellent control of all the weed species evaluated in our study.

halosulfuron can be applied PPI at 50 g ai/ha with triflural in, s-metolor, or imazet to control redroot pigweed and common ragweed and to provide excellent control of wild mustard and common lambsquarters.
